turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I have submitted the courtesy credit concession citing Goodwill Policy §4.2. You will see it credited to your account shortly.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My package arrived two days late. Does your company provide any compensation for late deliveries?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Under our carrier SLA courtesy credit guidelines (SOP-001), deliveries delayed by more than 48 hours qualify for shipping fee concessions.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: How much courtesy credit can be granted?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Depending on delay severity, standard compensation ranges from freight refund to up to $20.00 courtesy credit voucher.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is fair. Can you apply the shipping refund to my account?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I have processed a shipping fee credit of R$ 18,50 to your account under Goodwill Policy §4.2.
